scope: Records fixture diagnostic transport category wiring

observation.limitation: Prior receipt did not retain the existing harness CDP failure category. It cannot establish whether the request exception came from CDP or expression construction.

repair.path: Existing native harness transportFailureClass callback passed through the actual Records exercisePanel to the fixture helper.
repair.capture_boundary: Snapshot when the fixture request throws, before cleanup changes the shared CDP category.
repair.disclosure: Only fixed allowlisted categories, unrecognized, unavailable, or null; no arbitrary exception or response text.

verification.boundary_test: Actual Records callback and fixture helper distinguish protocol_error and command_timeout, suppress an unknown private-looking value, and retain the original category after cleanup changes it.
